name: U.S. Energy Information Administration
description: Official U.S. government energy statistics agency. Source for global oil transit chokepoint flow data and Brent crude spot prices.

name: Petroleum Planning & Analysis Cell
description: Indian government petroleum analysis body under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas. Source for India import/export, production, pricing, and refinery data.

name: Indian Strategic Petroleum Reserves Ltd
description: Government-owned company managing India's strategic petroleum reserves. Capacity data is public; current inventory is not officially published.

name: International Energy Agency
description: Intergovernmental energy policy and analysis organization. Source for global oil market analysis and supply security context.

name: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries
description: Intergovernmental oil producer organization. Source for production and demand outlook publications.

name: India Open Government Data
description: Indian open data portal for government datasets. Alternative source for petroleum statistics.
